capabilities: Set task status via emoji markers (todo, later, doing, done, cancel)
Toggle bullet lists and indent or outdent lines on desktop
Show a dedicated six-action toolbar on mobile and tablet
Detect the current task status automatically
extras: README is bilingual (English and Chinese); the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in toolbar for quickly setting task statuses, priorities, and list indentation while writing bullet lists.
summary: Minimalist toolbar that manages bullet list task status, priority, and list hierarchy in the editor on desktop and mobile.
